_README: Annotations extracted from the source PGN files by scripts/extract_annotations.py.
Keyed by FEN (board/side/castling/en-passant; move counters ignored).
Entries tagged 'extracted': true are machine-pulled from the PGN and may be
refreshed by re-running the extractor. Remove that tag (or write a new entry)
to mark one as hand-curated -- the extractor will then never touch it.
'source' records the annotator honestly. These collections differ a lot:
gm_games.pgn is credited to Irina Krush, great_masters.pgn names its club
annotators, and famous_games.pgn credits nobody -- so many entries say
